_readme: Manual corrections applied on top of the agents' annotations by scripts/merge-analysis.mjs. Keys are 'character id::skill name'; fields replace the agent's. extraCost = chakra the game text adds on top of the listed cost; cdOverride = minimum cooldown implied by the text.

female-animal-path-pein-(s)::Animal Path.note: Costs 1 extra random chakra per animal (about 2 used); animals locked out 3 turns after.

female-animal-path-pein-(s)::Rampaging B.note: Pre-selects an animal: it cannot be chosen again for 3 turns after it is summoned.

female-animal-path-pein-(s)::Venomous Ce.note: Pre-selects an animal: it cannot be chosen again for 3 turns after it is summoned.

female-animal-path-pein-(s)::Giant Crab.note: Pre-selects an animal: it cannot be chosen again for 3 turns after it is summoned.

female-animal-path-pein-(s)::Stampeding.note: Pre-selects an animal: it cannot be chosen again for 3 turns after it is summoned.

edo-tensei-kimimaro-(s)::Bone Spikes.note: Stacks with no stated limit; capped at 3 uses as a judgement call.

edo-tensei-kuriarare-(s)::Wire String.note: Marks one enemy per use, so at most three useful uses.

edo-tensei-mangetsu-(s)::Impure World Re.note: Text: may only be used 5 times.

edo-tensei-yagura-(s)::Water Mirror.note: Cannot be used twice on the same target.

edo-tensei-yagura-(s)::Reflective Mirror.note: Text: disabled for 2 turns when activated.

et-sandaime-raikage-(s)::Three Finger Nu.note: One-time permanent damage reduction that unlocks other skills.

et-susanoo-itachi-(s)::Edo Tensei Susano.note: Auto-triggers once when his health drops to 35 or less.

fuuton-naruto-(s)::Wind Destruction.note: Follow-up to the clone state; not usable every turn.

hanzo-of-the-salamander-(s)::Explosive T.note: Triggers once, when Ibuse is killed.

hiruko-sasori-(s)::Puppet Reveal.note: Text: can only be used once.

inuzuka-kiba::Dynamic Air Marking.note: Cannot be reapplied to an enemy already marked.

shinobi-alliance-neji-(s)::A Fate of His.note: Text: can only be used once.

utakata-(s)::Bubble Prision.note: Permanent damage on one target; three enemies at most.

raikage-(s)::Lightning Release.note: Costs 1 more random chakra each time it is used.

susanoo-itachi-(s)::Susanoo Activation.note: Cannot be used while active; one activation per game.

temari-(s)::Fan Increase Moon.note: Text: can only be used 3 times.

tenten-(s)::Weapon Upgrade.note: Replaced by another skill for 1 turn after use.

tsunade::Creation Rebirth.note: Only fires when Revitalizing Heal is used on herself.

white-zetsu-(s)::Clones Assault.note: Costs 1 additional random chakra at 3/6/9 clones.

yahiko-(s)::Final Command.note: Only below 25 health and kills Yahiko; once per game.

kankuro-(s)::Salamander Puppet.note: One-turn protection; not meant to be chained every turn.

akimichi-chouji::Akimichi Pills.note: Three pills in total; each costs 15 health (self-damage is not scored).
